entries.anchor: UF-085 - Implementation Ready Usage Accounting Contract
entries.grounds: THE canonical UsageRecord schema: identity/correlation (usage_event_ref, dedupe_key), source_class enum, settlement_status enum, token buckets, counting_semantics, cost_microdollars, windows. Buckets present even when unknown; PM never adds subset fields back onto inclusive provider totals.
entries.topic: token buckets; inclusive/exclusive; settlement; cost; windows
entries.requirement_summary: Token buckets (first-class, present even when unknown): input_total, input_non_cached, cache_read, cache_write, cache_write_1h, cache_write_ttl?, output_total, output_visible, reasoning/thoughts, provider_total, context_estimate. counting_semantics states whether cache is a subset of input and whether reasoning/thoughts are a subset of output. source_class = provider_reported|provider_header|cli_reported|local_estimated|pricing_estimated|unknown. settlement_status = observed|streaming_partial|settled|adjusted|failed|unknown (+observed_at_utc, settled_at_utc?, adjusted_at_utc?, failure_class?, partial_reason?). Costs: cost_microdollars and/or provider minor units, currency, cost_status, pricing_snapshot_id, pricing_source, pricing_effective_at, pricing_version, per-bucket costs, unknown-cost fail-closed. Windows normalized rolling/fixed/billing/session/unknown with reset/cooldown evidence; missing reset/disabled/missing cost or quota render unknown/not_exposed/disabled, not guessed countdowns or zeroes.
prohibitions: Do not add cache_read/cache_write/cache_write_1h to input_total when the provider says input_total is already inclusive
Do not add reasoning/thoughts to output_total when the provider says output_total is already inclusive
Do not turn context_estimate into billing, cost, quota, or provider authority
Do not display missing, disabled, unsupported, blocked, stale, or unknown cost/quota as zero
Do not fabricate reset countdowns, remaining quota, or cost from status/login probes
entries.missing_detail: depends_on UF-023, UF-035, UF-036, UF-040, UF-041, UF-074, UF-080; unblocks RAP-043, CBP-027

entries.anchor: UF-087 - UsageRecord GUI Projection And Alias Contract
entries.grounds: PER-VALUE provenance grammar on every visible value; no second cost model; no double-count; no fabrication; object-first identity.
entries.topic: per-value provenance; alias normalization; no-double-count; Antigravity states
entries.requirement_summary: Every visible token/context/cost/quota/credit/cache/reasoning/provider-total/context-estimate value carries value_state, source_class, source_confidence, source_authority, settlement_status, projection_freshness, projection_health, observed_at_utc or last_updated, and reason when degraded/estimated/unknown/disabled/not_exposed/hidden_byok/hidden_subscription. Aliases (usage_id, input_tokens, output_tokens, cache_read_tokens, cache_creation_input_tokens, cost_usd, usage_source_kind, UnifiedUsageRecord, estimated_cost_microdollars, final_cost_microdollars) reconcile to UF-085 before aggregation. usage_event_ref/UsageRecord identity primary; thread_id/tier_id/timestamp/run_id are filters only. Antigravity antigravity_cli/agy: missing /stats=unavailable, /usage=unknown, /quota=not exposed, /credits=not exposed; G1 credits never render as tokens/cost/quota/provider_total.
prohibitions: Do not render unknown, not exposed, hidden, disabled, stale, estimated, failed, partial, or unsupported values as zero
Do not add cache buckets to input totals or reasoning/thoughts to output totals when counting_semantics says the provider total is inclusive
No UI path fabricates reset countdowns, remaining quota, price snapshots, or raw provider payload content from status/login probes

entries.anchor: UF-088 - GUI Usage Acceptance Fixture Matrix
entries.grounds: Closed fixture matrix proving missing-vs-zero, no-double-count, settlement, BYOK/subscription hidden, disabled quota, cache-zero-vs-unsupported, partial/aborted, Antigravity, object-first route, Raw redaction.
entries.requirement_summary: GUI-USG-001 missing usage (source_class/confidence/authority unknown; never zero); GUI-USG-002 provider-reported zero (settled/adjusted + raw ref); GUI-USG-003 unknown cost (cost_status unknown, null cost, not $0.00); GUI-USG-004 BYOK/subscription hidden; GUI-USG-005 disabled quota bucket (no zero remaining/countdown/progress); GUI-USG-006 cache zero vs unsupported; GUI-USG-007 inclusive/exclusive no-double-count; GUI-USG-008 partial/aborted stream (counted once); GUI-CBP-001/002 Antigravity; GUI-ROUTE-001 object-first; GUI-RAW-001 redaction; GUI-RAP-001 envelope+per-type.
prohibitions: Do not let any fixture pass if unknown/hidden/disabled/not-exposed/missing values render as zero

entries.anchor: UF-086 - Provider Parser Fixture And Acceptance Contract
entries.grounds: Per-provider inclusive/exclusive counting + cost policy fixtures; each parser states cache-subset-of-input, reasoning-subset-of-output, provider_total authoritative-or-derived, context_estimate local-only.
entries.requirement_summary: OpenAI: cached+reasoning tokens, output_total inclusive when payload says so. Anthropic: cache_read/cache_write/cache_write_1h or TTL-specific, message_start + final message_delta settlement, fallback when TTL breakdown not exposed. Gemini: cachedContentTokenCount + thoughtsTokenCount, candidates visible-only, inclusive output = candidates+thoughts only when both proven. Bedrock: cache-aware input + provider/header authority. OpenRouter: BYOK + upstream cost + hidden/suppressed display. Custom providers: price rows for input/output/cacheRead/cacheWrite/cacheWrite1h + context window/max tokens/reasoning flags/cache-control format.
prohibitions: Do not treat missing usage, null usage, unknown cost, disabled quota, or broken /stats as zero
Do not let provider compatibility flags silently change cache/reasoning semantics without a fixture

entries.anchor: UF-074 - Provider Usage Source Confidence And Missing-Vs-Zero Contract
entries.grounds: source_confidence = high|medium|low|unknown; value-state taxonomy missing/unavailable/unsupported/blocked/stale/estimated/provider-reported/zero; missing displayed as missing, not zero.
entries.requirement_summary: Separately distinguish missing, unavailable, unsupported, blocked, stale, estimated, provider-reported, and zero through value_state, projection state, source_class, source_authority, settlement_status, or cost_status. Media/coding-plan usage must disclose whether it comes from provider status-line fields, direct provider API metadata, artifact receipts, local estimates, or unavailable source state.
prohibitions: Do not display missing usage as zero
Do not infer usage source confidence from provider family alone
Do not expose secret material in usage diagnostics or receipts

entries.anchor: UF-041 - Usage Window Model And Platform Semantics

entries.anchor: Canonical usage-window model
entries.grounds: window_kind enum (5 values) + window_scope + rolling/fixed/billing/session/unknown semantics; MiniMax fixed 5h.
entries.requirement_summary: window_kind = rolling|fixed_reset|billing_cycle|session_only|unknown; window_label; window_scope = provider|account|account+model|org|server_profile. rolling = sliding lookback; fixed_reset = fixed reset boundary/countdown; billing_cycle = tied to plan/billing period; session_only = authoritative local session/tool stats, no durable provider quota window; unknown = inferred/estimated only if labeled.
prohibitions: unknown window must not pretend to know reset semantics
conflicts: window_kind has 5 values; '5-hour'/'weekly' are window_label/duration values, NOT window_kind values; UF-085 uses shortened rolling/fixed/billing/session/unknown

entries.anchor: Canonical UsageRecord fields (alias normalization + cost display tiers)
entries.grounds: Alias->canonical mapping; cost_microdollars canonical; cost_usd display-only; 6/4/2dp tiers; source_class closed set.
entries.topic: alias mapping; cost authority; display precision
entries.requirement_summary: input_tokens->input_total; output_tokens->output_total; cache_read_tokens/cached_input_tokens/cache_creation_input_tokens->cache_read/cache_write/cache_write_1h/cache_write_ttl only when mapper states TTL + inclusive/exclusive. Canonical cost = cost_microdollars, provider minor units, currency, cost_status, pricing_snapshot_id/version/date/source, custom-provider price row refs. cost_usd = cost_microdollars/1_000_000 derived only at display/export/migration edges. Display tiers: <$0.01=6dp, <$1=4dp, else 2dp. source_class closed set: provider_reported, provider_header, cli_reported, local_estimated, pricing_estimated, unknown.
prohibitions: cost_usd must not be the only canonical precision source
raw-cost fields must not become independent billing authority

entries.anchor: Summary table + Cooldown/reset display rule + coding-plan reset semantics
entries.grounds: Authoritative reset/cooldown outranks local counters; Unknown reset, never fabricated; Alibaba 5h/weekly/monthly preserved separately; MiniMax 5h fixed; Z.AI plan-dependent.
entries.requirement_summary: Cooldown/reset display rule: authoritative_rate_limit_or_cooldown and explicit provider reset/cooldown values OUTRANK local counters; known reset/cooldown tick live; unknown renders 'Unknown reset'/'Unknown cooldown end', never a fabricated countdown. Alibaba Coding Plan has fixed reset windows at 5-hour, weekly, AND monthly boundaries that must be PRESERVED (labels+evidence) not flattened. MiniMax = fixed 5-hour fixed_reset. Z.AI = plan-dependent reset. Keep documented/default expectation separate from effective observed state.
prohibitions: never a fabricated countdown
preserve window labels/evidence instead of flattening into a generic quota bucket
Z.AI: do not present a fixed reset countdown until the active plan proves exact windows
entries.missing_detail: No explicit single sentence forbidding deriving/synthesizing a WEEKLY reset from a 5-HOUR reset; implied by preserve-separately + no-fabrication (gap U2)

entries.anchor: UsagePressureState + provider lifecycle (AuthState/ProviderReadiness)
entries.grounds: UsagePressureState enum; resolution_outcome; post-reset eligible_pending_recheck->validating->nominal; cooldown facts outrank overlays.
entries.requirement_summary: UsagePressureState = nominal|approaching_threshold|threshold_reached|exhausted|unknown. Provider-agnostic; maps authoritative counters, authoritative blocks, monthly-plan exhaustion, or weaker inferred pressure. 'unhealthy' is health/readiness, NOT pressure. provider-reported cooldown windows remain facts; user overlays (Temporary Pause/Resume Now/Mark Needs Recheck) must NOT overwrite provider metadata. Post-reset: reset_at/cooldown_until passing -> eligible_pending_recheck -> validating -> nominal. Threshold/exhaustion records resolution_outcome (honored|unknown|owner-defined). Usage warnings expose configurable threshold, dismiss/quiet window, path to Usage/config.
prohibitions: an unhealthy provider must not be collapsed into usage pressure
user overlays MUST NOT overwrite the provider-reported cooldown metadata

entries.anchor: Usage and Billing Contracts Addendum (shard 015: cost type, token buckets, attribution, spending limits, cache accounting, billing entity)
entries.grounds: Microdollar cost type; canonical token buckets; total_tokens no-double-count; attribution tuple; window_scope; spending limits; cache accounting; conditional billing entity.
entries.topic: persisted cost type + token bucket + attribution contracts
entries.requirement_summary: All persisted usage/cost values are integer microdollars (u64); presentation converts, storage/accumulation does not. Canonical buckets individually persisted or explicitly unknown/not_exposed; storage-layer aggregation/collapse prohibited; every LLM call (incl. title gen, summaries, hidden helper passes, subagents) emits separated buckets + counting_semantics. total_tokens MAY be derived for convenience but MUST NOT replace buckets or double-count provider-inclusive cache/reasoning. Attribution preserves provider_id, model_id, account_id?, provider_account_ref?, parent_run_id, billing_entity_id?, entitlement_class?, source_class/source_confidence/source_authority, window_label + window_scope (provider|account|account+model|org|server_profile), cache_hit?, cache_strategy?. Keyed by (provider_id, model_id, account_id?, billing_entity_id?, entitlement_class?). Cost accumulation monotonic/non-decreasing/non-negative; negative display always an explicit adjustment record. cost_usd presentation-only; <$0.01=>6dp. Spending limits read canonical stream; kill.budget_exceeded (pre-dispatch) / done.budget_exceeded (post-response). OpenRouter cache-write maps into canonical cache buckets. requested/effective_billing_entity_id conditionally required.
prohibitions: total_tokens MUST NOT replace the UF-085 buckets or double-count provider-inclusive cache/reasoning
Storage-layer aggregation or collapse into a smaller field set is prohibited
MUST NOT collapse the attribution tuple to billing_entity_id alone when account or entitlement context exists
run.completed.usage MUST NOT use the legacy (tokens_in, tokens_out, cost, thread_id) tuple

entries.anchor: CV-316 - GUI Usage Route Subject Payload Contract (shard 040)
entries.grounds: Object-first usage routing; correlation/projection fields; Raw/Curated redaction.
entries.requirement_summary: GUI Usage route/open payloads normalize every drill-through into route_target.object_kind = usage_event + object_id when usage_event_ref exists. Correlation/projection fields: usage_event_ref, usage_record_id, provider_attempt_ref, attempt_id, node_id, tool_call_id, trace_ref, receipt refs, raw_payload_ref, artifact_id, run_id, thread_id, source_class, source_confidence, source_authority, settlement_status, projection_freshness, projection_health. thread_id/tier_id/timestamp/run_id can filter but cannot replace UsageRecord identity. Curated = normalized fields; Raw = redacted refs/hashes/omitted counts/permission state.
prohibitions: Do not let usage_event_ref bypass object-first route normalization
Do not use timestamp/run_id/thread_id/tier_id as primary Usage route identity when usage_event_ref exists

entries.anchor: F3-418 - Usage Value-State Rendering And Identity Contract (shard 057)
entries.grounds: Per-cell value-state matrix in the GUI; cache-zero-vs-unsupported; identity; Antigravity states.
entries.requirement_summary: Every visible Usage/Ledger/Dashboard-usage-widget/chat-context/Context-Detail/Runtime-Artifacts/provider-settings/model-row/Run-Graph/Orchestrator usage row renders UsageRecord projections through a shared value-state matrix: value, value_state, source_class, source_confidence, source_authority, settlement_status, projection_freshness, projection_health, last_updated or observed_at_utc, reason, raw/debug redaction. Cells render disabled, not_exposed, unknown, stale, estimated, hidden_byok, hidden_subscription, streaming_partial, failed, adjusted, and provider-reported zero as DISTINCT states. Cache zero is a real zero only with source_class/source_confidence evidence. Dashboard usage widgets use the same matrix or remain explicitly unavailable (no zero-for-missing).
prohibitions: Do not render missing/unknown/hidden/stale/disabled/not-exposed/partial/failed/unsupported values as zero
Do not infer Antigravity usage/quota/credits/countdowns from status/login/model probes

entries.anchor: Projection trust grammar + projection_freshness/projection_health enums
entries.grounds: projection_freshness = current|refreshing|stale; projection_health = healthy|degraded|unavailable; trust_tier reserved for preview/browser.
entries.requirement_summary: Projection-backed surfaces display projection_freshness and projection_health as the runtime trust grammar; trust_tier is reserved for preview/browser, NOT runtime degraded trust; projection-backed panels expose trust state + last updated as first-class fields. Every History/Ledger/Evidence/Usage/Runtime-Artifacts surface renders projection_freshness = current|refreshing|stale independently from projection_health = healthy|degraded|unavailable. A projection rebuilt to the current survivor checkpoint may be current and still degraded. Sensitive actions require current data or direct revalidation; degraded falls back to record-backed views and suppresses live mutation.
prohibitions: runtime degraded copy never reuses trust_tier as degraded trust
no surviving projection makes lost canonical bytes repaired

entries.anchor: 9.4 Usage and runtime visibility
entries.grounds: What usage/status surfaces MUST show (effective account/auth/billing, pressure/cooldown, source-confidence/stale/estimated, switch reason).
entries.requirement_summary: Usage and status surfaces MUST show: current effective account or server profile; current effective auth mode; current effective billing/entity context when relevant; pressure/cooldown state; source-confidence, stale, or estimated labels when data is not authoritative; switch/failover reason when PM changed the selected unit. Prefer plain-language statuses (Working / concrete failure reason).

entries.anchor: MA-063 - Direct Provider Subscription And Usage Authority Boundaries
entries.grounds: Per-provider usage authority; Claude Code status-line five_hour/seven_day fields (separate used_percentage + resets_at).
entries.requirement_summary: Direct-provider subscription/usage authority is provider-specific. GitHub Copilot readiness from direct hosted API + Copilot entitlement token, not copilot CLI bridging. Claude Code status-line rate_limits is the accepted usage source rather than OAuth usage polling. Preserved tokens: five_hour.used_percentage, five_hour.resets_at, seven_day.used_percentage, seven_day.resets_at, statusLine, refreshInterval - i.e. 5h and 7d are SEPARATE fields each with their own used_percentage and resets_at. OpenAI/Codex subscription image generation separate from API-key billing. Z.AI/Zhipu plan/overload/balance/resource states surfaced accurately, not as user-action blockers.
prohibitions: Do not poll or store secrets where provider-owned status-line or direct API usage metadata is sufficient
Do not hide upstream/account gating behind generic provider failure copy

entries.anchor: MA-022 - No-Switch Cooldown Retry Budget Manual Override And Exhausted Copy
entries.grounds: cooldown_until sets hard_block=true until revalidation; exhausted copy visible when fallback available.
entries.requirement_summary: PM does not auto-switch when no eligible backup exists, policy forbids, capability unsupported, hard requested constraint forbids fallback, or explicit recovery required. Cooldown and retry budget are first-class account state; cooldown_until sets hard_block=true until revalidation after expiry. Manual set-active remains override/debug. Exhausted copy: 'Usage exhausted' / 'Puppet Master will use another eligible account until this one resets'.
prohibitions: Manual control does not redefine the default operating model

entries.anchor: Antigravity CLI usage/quota collection (CBP-027 region)
entries.grounds: Non-authoritative quota: missing /stats,/usage,/quota,/credits -> unavailable/unknown/not exposed; G1 credits never tokens/cost; disabled buckets no fabricated progress; reset/cooldown unknown not guessed.
entries.requirement_summary: Antigravity CLI is a separate antigravity_cli provider route backed by agy (not Gemini Direct, not retired gemini_cli). Probes agy --version, agy models, /usage, /quota, /credits, /stats only when available, Models & Quota page, statusline JSON. source_class = cli_reported or unknown unless a provider/header/API source is directly proven. Models & Quota disabled buckets render disabled, omit fabricated progress bars, do not become zero remaining quota. /credits, UseG1Credits, remaining credits, G1 credits are credit/overflow-pool signals, NOT token usage/model cost/provider_total. Missing/broken /stats renders stats unavailable and usage unknown or quota not exposed (not proof of no usage). Missing /usage,/quota,/credits,Models & Quota,statusline,reset,cooldown renders usage unknown, quota not exposed, credits not exposed, reset unknown, or cooldown unknown rather than guessed countdowns.
prohibitions: never maps quota progress, G1 credits, statusline context, or disabled quota buckets into token/cost counters
disabled buckets do not become zero remaining quota
missing reset/cooldown renders reset unknown / cooldown unknown rather than guessed countdowns
